[[Private/Legends|Private]] '''Vausam''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during their [[Third Galactic War|third war]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed in the hidden Imperial base on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Dantooine Incursion]].
